name: Large Trefoil
desc: Large Trefoil (Trifolium aureum): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Trifolium aureum, known by the various common names large hop trefoil, large trefoil, large hop clover, golden clover or hop clover, is a species of flowering plant native to much of Eurasia.
